title: List the three oldest distinct patients who have abnormal total bilirubin (
question: List the three oldest distinct patients who have abnormal total bilirubin (≥2.0), a peripheral ANA pattern (containing 'P'), and either normal prothrombin time (<14) or normal white blood cell count (3.5–9.0). Return their ID, sex, admission status, and birthday.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    T1."XCL_058",
    T1."XCL_059",
    T2."XCL_013",
    T1."XCL_060"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1."XCL_058" = T3."XCL_014"
WHERE T3."XCL_037" >= 2.0
  AND T2."XCL_006" LIKE '%P%'
  AND (T3."XCL_028" < 14 OR T3."XCL_030" BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0)
ORDER BY T1."XCL_060" ASC
LIMIT 3
